sentences.text: This extinct animal belonged to the class of cartilaginous fish, a group that includes sharks and rays.
It was placed within the family known as Psephodontidae.
Remains were uncovered on the Kanin Peninsula within Russia's Nenets Autonomous District.
This creature lived during the Guadalupian epoch of the Permian period.
Its existence spanned from 274.4 to 266.9 million years ago.
